actions.newValue: Dear Evan Hansen is a musical by Steven Levenson, Benj Pasek and Justin Paul about Evan Hansen, an anxious high school senior whose life changes when a classmate's death is mistaken for a close friendship with him. As the lie grows, the story follows its effect on Evan, the family he lets in, and a community looking for something to hold onto. This North American tour of the 2016 Broadway production ran from September 2024 to April 2025.
